habitat: Anecdote captions describing an implausible run of misfortune.
diet: Feeds on the gap between a mundane school photo and an absurd caption of bad luck.
predators: None litigated; the exposure here is upstream, in who actually owns the photograph.
transmission: Unaltered photograph, recaptioned per instance; the image itself is never redrawn.
cause_of_death: Slow fade as the captioning format aged out of active rotation.
resurrection: Occasional nostalgia reposts, usually without a new caption.
host_population: General; the format survives mainly as a reference rather than active production.
mutation: None to the image. Any mutation here is legal, not visual: the studio, not the family, may hold the underlying copyright.
prognosis: Do not assume a licence is available even if the subject offers one. The photographer's estate or the studio may be the real rights holder.
rights_holder: Kyle Craven, with the photographer's interest unclear
enforcement_history: No litigation found. Subject sold an NFT in 2021.
curatorial_note: Chain of title is genuinely murky. School portrait copyright often sits with the studio, not the family. Do not assume the subject can licence it.
